# Viral Flux Media - Digital Marketing Agency

> Premier results-driven social media marketing, cinematic 4K viral reel production, and performance paid advertising agency based in Dombivli, Maharashtra, serving brands across Kalyan, Thane, Mumbai, and worldwide.

Viral Flux Media - Digital Marketing Agency is a full-service creative media and digital growth agency headquartered in Dombivli (Thane district), Maharashtra, India. We specialize in on-location 4K cinema filming, algorithmic short-form video hooks, hyper-local Meta & Google advertising, and automated WhatsApp lead-generation funnels.

- [Social Media Marketing Agency in Thane](https://viralfluxmedia.in/social-media-marketing-agency-thane): Growth marketing, viral video production, and paid ads for scaling brands in Thane and Majiwada.

- [Reel Makers & Video Production in Dombivli](https://viralfluxmedia.in/video-production-reel-editing-dombivli): On-location 4K cinema shoots, 1.5-second retention hooks, cinematic color grading, and studio sound design.
